results.Summary: Airstream, Inc. (Airstream) is recalling certain 2021 Flying Cloud, Bambi, Caravel, Classic, Globetrotter, and International recreational vehicles, equipped with Winntec model 6020 two-stage propane regulators.  The regulator may fail, causing an increase in propane pressure.
results.Consequence: Increased propane pressure can enlarge the flames in gas appliances, increasing the risk of a fire.
results.Remedy: Dealers will inspect and replace the regulator, as necessary, and test the propane system for leaks, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed October 8, 2021.  Owners may contact Airstream customer service at 1-877-596-6505 or 1-937-596-6111 ext. 7401 or 7411.
results.Notes: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153), or go to www.nhtsa.gov.

results.Summary: Airstream, Inc. (Airstream) is recalling certain 2020 25RB, 26RB, 28RB, 30RB Flying Cloud, 25RB, 28RB, 30RB Flying Cloud, and 2021 25RB, 28RB, 30RB Flying Cloud, and International travel trailers.  The stove top range was incorrectly installed in a non-sealed cabinet.
results.Consequence: A draft can cause the flame to enter the non-sealed cabinet, increasing the risk of a fire.
results.Remedy: Dealers will install panels/baffling in the cabinet to isolate negative airflow and prevent flame inversion, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed July 7, 2021.  Owners may contact Airstream customer service at 1-877-596-6505 or 1-937-596-6111 ext. 7401 or 7411.
results.Notes: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153), or go to www.safercar.gov.
